title: Proper postcomposition of a compactification model
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X to Y separated finite type between Noetherian schemes, c a compactification, and p:Y to Z proper with Z Noetherian. Whiskering t_c with F_p and applying the chosen compact-support compositor equals the associator, the chosen proper comparison for p [def-pur-graph-chosen-proper-comparison] under open extension and Rc.g_*, the canonical derived direct-image compositor, and t_(c.postcomp p) [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons].

source.place: Tags 0F7B (proper/quasi-finite interchange), 0F7F (change of base), 0F7I and 0F7J (composition); proper/open tower in parent steps 1–3. Graph normalization: etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L.

proof.text: Apply the every-triangle formula to c, ofIsProper p and c.postcomp p. The intermediate open is the identity, so identity-open exchange and the open-composition unit law cancel the identity factors. The remaining proper compositor is the canonical derived direct-image compositor. Cancel the inverse and forward t_c by naturality. Empty and identity cases obey the same unit laws.

theorem graph_proper_postcomposition
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Z]
    {f : X ⟶ Y} [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasCompactification f] (c : Compactification f)
    (p : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper p] [HasCompactification (f ≫ p)] :
    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A c)
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p) ≪≫
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A f p =
    Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i).mapDerivedCategory
        (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
          (graphChosenProperComparison A p) ≪≫
          rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g p) ≪≫
      rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A (c.postcomp p)
